name: service-sheet
title: Draft order of service
for_each: select id,code from church.services where status='planned'

sections.title: Service
sections.sql: select name,starts_at,ends_at,campus from church.services where id=$1

sections.title: Running order
sections.sql: select position,name,minutes,musical_key from church.service_order where service_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Assigned volunteers
sections.sql: select team,role,volunteer,status from church.roster where service_id=$1 order by team,role

sections.title: Upcoming assignments
sections.sql: select s.code service,s.starts_at,r.name role,p.name volunteer,a.status from church.assignments a join church.roles r on r.id=a.role_id join church.services s on s.id=r.service_id join church.people p on p.id=a.person_id where r.team_id=$1 and s.status='planned' and s.starts_at>=current_date order by s.starts_at

name: followup-letter
title: Internal follow-up draft
for_each: select id,code from church.followups where status='open'

sections.title: For review by the coordinator
sections.note: Internal brief only. Write and approve the actual message before sending through your usual channel.
sections.sql: select p.name recipient,f.name subject,f.owner,f.due_on,f.purpose from church.followups f join church.people p on p.id=f.person_id where f.id=$1
